Specification: This module is a thin wrapper around another specification, intended to provide Apalache type annotations for the TokenRing specification while keeping the original module free of tool-specific annotations. It declares integer constants N and M, an integer-valued variable c typed as a function from Int to Int, and defines vars as the tuple << c >>. The module itself does not define an algorithm, transition relation, or temporal properties; instead, it instantiates the TokenRing module without explicit substitutions.
